protocol.scope: Descriptive matched ARM validation; no superiority, non-inferiority or fastest-lap claim
protocol.firmware: Frozen November 13 TROPIC RT1064 simulation ELFs; controller equations unchanged
protocol.plant: Existing 2 kg, 500 mm diagonal Rumoca plant; no physical parameters changed

inputs.noise: Same seed and sample schedule, fixed-hover-reference vibration independent of actual motor outputs; retain binary innovations to verify SHA-256 equality
inputs.quantization: Match BF virtual int16 IMU: truncation, +/-32767 counts; gyro16.4LSB/deg/s; accel2048LSB/g
inputs.attitude: Same 35-degree normal-stick map; +/-0.035-degree quantization tolerance; fixed yaw=0
inputs.acro: Outside primary figure-eight qualification; historical nominal10deg/s discrepancy is preserved and not relabeled matched

tuning.requalification: Four fresh 5-degree signed roll/pitch probes per stack, realistic seed1, fresh hover per probe
tuning.action_if_failed: Retain failure; do not call inherited tuning ARM-qualified. Fixed-gain baseline comparisons remain diagnostic.

gates.course: one ordered figure-eight, full extents and center return

protocol.scoring: Post-step ground-truth vs held100Hz reference at8000Hz, t25 through lap_end inclusive; binary raw scoring samples retained for independent recalculation
protocol.failures: Retain all attempts. A timeout is an infrastructure failure, never a performance boundary.

metrics.integrated_orientation_scope: generated FF, zero position/velocity/orientation state error and fixed heading; reference-force derivatives only; not general closed-loop stability
pending_gates: stock ANGLE/ATTITUDE hover and step tests
closed-loop takeoff, square, figure eight and landing
metrics.precision: generated IEEE float32 versus f64 analytic oracle; not formal floating-point proof

exactLoop.scope: Numerical validation of the exact supplied compiled flight library; no regeneration or substitution

nativeChecks.scope: Separate host-native Zephyr image, not the frozen ARM campaign firmware. Valid-reference echo, invalid-ingress rejection and odometry-before-plan.

firmwareRebuilds.scope: ELF entry point, ARM ABI flags, load-segment bytes, addresses, zero-initialized memory sizes, permissions and alignment. Debug/symbol-only changes are excluded. Does not establish physical board readiness.

checks.label: Exact flight-library oracle, derivative and orientation checks
40 s lap: three noise profiles × five repeats × off/on
Paired config, shared artifacts, noise bytes and counters
Raw scoring, input cadence, configuration and commands
